dialogs.title: Chats
dialogs.text:
Chats
done
Got it
Choose a chat list

Filter conversations by their purpose.

Show all chats or filter by Event, Sub-event, Group, Service, or App Support. Red counters show unread items.

Read a chat row

See the latest activity before opening it.

A row shows the latest sender, channel, recent message, time, member count, and unread count. Tap it to open the conversation.

Channel types

Keep each conversation in the right place.

Event chats cover the whole event, sub-event chats cover one part, and group chats cover a smaller team. Service and App Support chats handle their own help or system-related topics.

Open a conversation

Read messages and use the available actions.

The header opens members, the related event or group, and pinned messages. Message actions depend on ownership and content: you may reply, react, edit or unsend your own message, pin it, open an attachment, or report it.

Send more than text

Use chat tools for practical planning.

The plus button lets you add an image, voice clip, poll, event, or asset. Shared items stay in the conversation so participants can open them later.
